exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: original Silent Storm UI diffuse artwork 7710, complete source1024x256 canvas.
Input image: exact ORIGINAL complete storedRGB painting, source-only entire nativeRGB canvas NEAREST affine resize to1536x512 aspect3:1. Reference helper is1536x512 and is the ONLY geometry/material reference, not an inspiration image. Original native alpha is separately restored by root final pack; this guide adds no artwork.
Primary request: refine only this exact original painting faithfully into HD. Preserve every normalized source UV location, all original component/slot/line/mark counts, occupied footprint, contour, spacing, scale and all broad material light/dark patches. Keep the WHOLE supplied helper canvas edge-to-edge at aspect1536:512, including all original black space. The complete generated3:1 canvas will later be resized back to original4x aspect. Do NOT correct the intentional source-only affine squeeze, crop/rearrange components or add outside space; keep every shape in its supplied helper normalized coordinates.
Source-specific invariants: The complete wide source contains a large exact BLACK TOP band, the lower-left long plain dark brown-grey mottled metal field, the original narrow long lower metal strip, and the far-right source black small slot arrangement. Keep TWO rows of FOUR small square black slots, the narrow vertical stack of THREE black slots immediately to their left, exact source clipping, positions and sizes, thin original borders and remaining empty black right upper field. Preserve source dark matte fine grain/patch scale, no extra cell/row, white glints, screw, text, picture or ornamental curl.
Material: the original quiet matte metal or softly aged plain paper painting, same source palette, same weak broad mottled regions and exact pattern/stain scale. Resolve coarse pixels only into a restrained finer version of the SAME source material. Keep original low-contrast grain/shading and relative edge intensity. Do not add new fine decorative pattern, gritty raised texture, brighter rim or glossy chrome. Numeric brightness correction happens later; never redesign or relight.
Constraints: FULL canvas, no crop, zoom, recenter, shift, rotation, bounding-box fitting, padding, additional whitespace/frame, repacking, atlas or scene. Every original black empty/cut-out/blank area stays exactly as source. No new row/grid/slot, arrow, fold, page, tear, clip, bolt, screw, star, fleck, scratches, curls or hardware. No added text/font/numeral/logo/flag/portrait/photo or new symbol. Preserve any explicitly noted pre-existing close mark exactly without changing it or inventing other markings. Do not decorate blank gray/black source fields. Return opaque fullcanvas RGB; generated alpha must not replace the original alpha. No transparent cut-out or color fringes. Only refine the existing source painting.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Source RGBA to native stored RGB only. Wholecanvas NEAREST resize to recorded helper_size. Aspect>3 uses exact1536x512 source-only fullcanvas affine3:1; all others native aspect nearest2x. Root-authorized inverse entire raw to original4x. NO crop/padding/rotation/BBox/UV fitting/inpainting/unpremultiplication/art insertion. Original source alpha separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: Entire raw LANCZOS to exact original.width*4,original.height*4; no crop/padding/autoBBox/composite.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
